title: Projects
description: content/data/projects.json: projects shown on the homepage and /projects, and in the resumes' Project Experience section. Array of entries.

organization.description: Organization or lab the project belongs to (optional). Shown under the image.

start.description: Start date. Free text, shown as written (e.g. "Sep 2024", "2023", "Present").

end.description: End date, or "Present". Free text, shown as written (e.g. "Sep 2024", "2023", "Present").

image.description: Project image (shown as a wide banner). Path of an image under public/, starting with "/" (e.g. "/images/lab-logo.png"). Rendered with next/image, so remote URLs and paths without the leading slash break the page. Defaults to /images/placeholder.png.

description.description: What you did. Each line (separated by \n) becomes a bullet; an empty string shows "In progress". Required: the Projects section crashes without it. Must be a string, not an array.

links.description: Buttons shown under the entry: an object mapping the button label to its URL, e.g. {"GitHub": "https://...", "Paper": "https://..."}. Labels containing preprint/paper/code/github/demo/slides/video/poster/website get matching icons. The resume title links to the first of "GitHub", "Website", "Poster", "Paper" that is present (unless resume_link is set).

additionalProperties.description: URL (absolute, or a path under public/ such as /assets/slides.pdf).

collaborators.description: People you worked with, shown as "Collaborators: A, B" with links.

link.description: Link to their homepage or profile (optional).

show_on_homepage.description: Set to false to list this entry only on /projects, not on the homepage.

show_on_website.description: Set to false to hide the entry on the website.

resume_title.description: Title to use on the resumes instead of title.

resume_link.description: URL the resume title links to. Defaults to links.GitHub, then Website, Poster, Paper.

resume_type.description: Right-hand label on the full CV, e.g. "Research Project". The four-part CV heading is used only when both resume_type and resume_skills are set.

resume_skills.description: Comma-separated skills shown on the resume heading, e.g. "Python, PyTorch". A single string, not an array.

resume_description.description: Bullets for the full CV. Defaults to the lines of description. LaTeX: & % _ $ are escaped automatically unless already escaped; other LaTeX commands (e.g. \\textbf{...}) pass through.

resume_short_description.description: Bullets for the short resume. Defaults to the lines of description. LaTeX: & % _ $ are escaped automatically unless already escaped; other LaTeX commands (e.g. \\textbf{...}) pass through.

resume_type_short.description: resume_type to use on the short resume instead.
